bridge.note: Italian makes recency a prepositional phrase (di recente); Spanish routes it through its time-machine verb hacer (hace poco) — the same hace that tells you how long ago anything happened. It is the same hace that measures distance into the past in hace dos años.

interference.es_to_it: 'Di reciente' is not Spanish — recency runs through hacer: hace poco, the same hace as hace dos años.
interference.it_to_es: 'Fa poco' alone is not the Italian marker; di recente or poco fa.
